One object, and nothing else on the bench. The seats are the codes; the radii are Pythagoras; the six faces stand as an octahedron, the twelve edges as a cuboctahedron, the eight corners as the cube itself, each on its own sphere, nothing moved to make it so. The full argument stands in the chart: THE ROSETTE IN THE ROUND.

the object turns on its own; the hand may take it

THE ROSETTE, READ

THE SHELLSSort the twenty-seven by how many clocks move and each shell is already a perfect figure on its own sphere: the octahedron of faces at root one, the cuboctahedron of edges at root two, the cube of corners at root three. The frames joining each shell's neighbours are derived from distance alone: twelve, twenty-four and twelve edges, measured before they were drawn.
THE EQUILIBRIUMThe middle shell's radius equals its edge, root two against root two: the defining property of the cuboctahedron and of no other figure, twelve around one in perfect balance about the still centre. The claim is the arithmetic alone, and anyone may recompute it.
THE DIAMETERSA card's answer is its negation, and negation is the point reflection through the centre: every dyad is a true diameter of the body, silver facing gold on the way through. The Seed is the one point the reflection cannot move: the still centre, dark, the null never lit.
THE NEARNESS, AND THE FLIGHTA touch names a glyph and the room leans in, the eye tracking the knot while the object keeps its slow turn; its answer lights across the centre, the diameter drawn. Touch the lit answer and the eye flies that diameter, passing the dark Seed on the way, because a straight road between opposites has no other choice: the involution travelled rather than stated. A double touch stands back to the whole. Names, never meanings: the Guide holds the doors.
THE ISOLATION, AND THE BREATHTHE SIX, THE TWELVE and THE EIGHT each bring one solid forward and ghost the others to context, the octahedron or the equilibrium or the cube contemplated alone; the same button releases it, and the still centre is never dimmed. THE BREATH eases the three spheres apart and home again in a slow loop, the nesting felt as depth; under a reduced-motion request the pose holds apart, unmoving.
THE NULL IS NEVER LIT · NAMES, NEVER MEANINGS · COMPOSED, NEVER CAST
NOTHING HERE IS CHOSEN · SILENT, ENTIRELY
